hypotheses.memory: At recordwise matched language-backbone lengths, real-video minus text-control peak isolates the frozen video decode/vision-forward residual. The full-step peak is max(language phase, vision phase), never their sum.
hypotheses.throughput: Step time is a shared mixed-token language component plus a video-forward component driven by raw patch units, sampled frames, and media launches.
hypotheses.resolution_arm: upscaled_64 is a controlled processor-resolution mechanism arm, not evidence that the downloaded source distribution contains high-resolution video.

data_quality: one decoded video and nonzero video_grid_thw per real-video sample
